title: GitBulk configuration
description: Configuration for the GitBulk CLI (YAML/JSON). Hand-maintained; mirrors the Zod schema in src/config/schema.ts. Add `# yaml-language-server: $schema=./schema/gitbulk.config.schema.json` to your YAML for editor autocomplete. Note: GitBulk's own validation is authoritative — this file is a best-effort aid and may lag behind newly added operations.

rus.description: Repository units to process. A comma-separated string, or an array of names and/or { repo, workspace } objects. Set `workspace` to target a different Bitbucket workspace / GitHub owner for that RU. Names and workspaces must start alphanumeric and contain only letters, digits, '.', '_', '-' (no path separators or '..').

ticket.description: Ticket identifier, prepended to the branch and commit message (e.g. AKB-1234). Uppercased; alphanumeric segments separated by single hyphens.

branch.description: Feature branch name (without the ticket prefix). The full branch becomes `<ticket>-<branch>`.

script.description: Path to a code-change script (.sh/.bash, .bat/.cmd, .ps1, .js/.mjs/.cjs, .ts/.mts/.cts). Set EITHER this OR `operations`, not both.

operations.description: Declarative code-change operations, run in order. Set EITHER this OR `script`. Each entry needs a `type`; remaining keys are operation-specific parameters (see `gitbulk list-operations`).

type.description: Operation type, e.g. maven-add-dependency, npm-add-dependency, npm-update, json-patch, add-file, replace-file, delete-file, regex-replace.

commitMessage.description: Commit message. The ticket is prepended automatically: `<ticket> <commitMessage>`.

createPrOnError.description: Create a PR even if the code change failed (commit is flagged 'ERROR WHILE CODE CHANGE: …').

workspaceDir.description: Root directory that contains the RU repositories. Defaults to the current working directory. A leading '~' is expanded to the home directory.

cloneIfMissing.description: Clone repositories that are not found locally instead of skipping them. Requires `cloneBaseUrl`.

cloneBaseUrl.description: Base URL for `git clone` (used only when `cloneIfMissing` is true), e.g. https://bitbucket.org/my-workspace/.

sourceBranch.description: Branch GitBulk checks out and resets to before creating the feature branch.

retry.description: Retry behaviour for `git push` and PR API calls.

concurrency.description: Number of RUs processed in parallel.

commandTimeoutMs.description: Timeout in milliseconds per git command (prevents hanging auth prompts).

dryRun.description: Dry-run mode: no writing git operations, no PR API calls.

skipHooks.description: Disable git hooks for all git commands (via core.hooksPath).

prPlatform.description: Pull-request platform. Tokens are read from the environment, never from this file.

bitbucket.description: Bitbucket settings (required when prPlatform is 'bitbucket'). Token: GITBULK_BITBUCKET_TOKEN.

github.description: GitHub settings (required when prPlatform is 'github'). Token: GITBULK_GITHUB_TOKEN.

apiBaseUrl.description: API base for GitHub Enterprise, e.g. https://ghe.example.com/api/v3.

azureDevOps.description: Azure DevOps settings (required when prPlatform is 'azure-devops'). Adapter not yet implemented.
